graph.label: Reading graph
graph.semantic: Typed directed relations between works (may contain cycles)
graph.question: What should I read before/after/with this work, and why?
graph.computed: All edges below; nodes = every node with >=1 edge; columns grouped by corpus, rows by year (living docs pinned to a top band); provenance per edge: report / derived / editorial.

facets.label: Facet browser
facets.semantic: Classification lattice: corpus x branch x theme x type (+ verification, role, lane)
facets.question: What exists about X, and how much of it is verified?
facets.computed: Pure filtering over node tags produced in PHASE 2; counts computed live.

timeline.label: Chronology
timeline.semantic: Ordering by year of last publication; living documents form their own stratum
timeline.question: How did the field accumulate; what is maintained vs frozen?
timeline.computed: parse leading 4-digit year; UNRESOLVED and living pinned to labelled bands.

overlap.label: Cross-corpus overlap
overlap.semantic: Works claimed by more than one research pass
overlap.question: Which works bind the corpora together (the graft points)?
overlap.computed: nodes with |corpora| >= 2, grouped by membership signature.

anchors.label: Anchors & spine
anchors.semantic: Curated per-corpus entry points: anchor/target/KEY-flagged nodes
anchors.question: Where do I start in each corpus?
anchors.computed: nodes whose role includes 'anchor' (swa stars, simulink targets, ops KEY flags), grouped by corpus.

spine.label: The spine
spine.semantic: Pass-9 coverage matrix: seven domains x five derivation stages
spine.question: How does a stakeholder need become a designed, tooled, measured system - and where is that chain unwritten?
spine.computed: Live counts over the nodes own stage/domain array facets (no inference). Thin cells carry the adversarial critic panels adjudication: literature-thin (the field never wrote that intersection) vs sweep-thin (the sweep looked in the wrong vocabulary).
